written.myAnswer: “Entrepreneur” comes from the French word entreprendre, meaning “to undertake.” An entrepreneur undertakes the work of starting and running a business.

Entrepreneurship supports economic growth by creating jobs and offering new products and services. It encourages innovation by bringing fresh ideas and competition, which can improve products and services. Examples include technology companies such as Facebook, Google, and Apple, which grew from innovative ideas, and smartphones, which changed communication and access to information.
